audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1, 2, 3 and 6 were shipped as Skill/Vayne/Vayne/Vayne while their own whys say you out-range every Tumble step-up and re-establish dominance at two items.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Ziggs, Ziggs, Ziggs, Ziggs, Ziggs, Vayne, Ziggs], the mirror audit set rows 1-3 to Ziggs on Vayne's page, and Tumble is only 300 range against your 850 Q.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 3 and 6 set to Ziggs in both layers with ratings raised to 7/10; row 5 left as Vayne, which both the packet and her first-item spike support.

audit.why: The spikes are already right: her one window is a completed AD item plus Condemn, and Final Hour (100/85/70s) adds AD, Tumble stealth and a shorter Tumble cooldown but no range, so level 6 does not take the stage from you.

audit.whatIsWrong: Condemn had no cooldown anywhere, and the page never stated the tell that actually matters: her burst opens with an auto-attack reset, not a visible cast.
audit.why: missingInteractions rule autoreset-burst-tell — Vayne's combo opens with Tumble (Q), an auto-attack reset on 6/5/4/3/2s at 300 range. Condemn is 20/18/16/14/12s at 550 range and only stuns if you collide with terrain, so open ground turns the stun into a plain knockback.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d now carries Condemn's 20s and the open-ground rule; dontsFull[1].t/.d rewritten around the Tumble reset wind-up.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page calls Vayne 'he' and describes Tumble as a dash that 'beats your range'.
audit.why: Tumble is a 300-range reposition, shorter than her 550 Condemn and far under your 850 Q — she has to walk, not dash, into you.
audit.corrected: tldr and report[0].t restated with the 300 range and correct pronoun; dontsFull[1].t retitled.
